title: 列車自動駕駛系統~Automatic train operation systems
focus: 由速度規畫到停準驗證的自動駕駛閉迴路~Automatic-driving feedback from speed planning to stopping verification
summary: 本課聚焦由速度規畫到停準驗證的自動駕駛閉迴路。從停準制動軌跡建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把節能滑行與回生與速度閉迴路時序連成可驗證的介面，最後以停準重複試驗推論整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies automatic-driving feedback from speed planning to stopping verification. Start with stopping brake trajectory to define physical or information boundaries, connect coasting and regenerative energy with speed-loop timing budget as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through inference from repeated stopping tests. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對由速度規畫到停準驗證的自動駕駛閉迴路而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用舒適加速度過渡及自動駕駛服務恢復連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For automatic-driving feedback from speed planning to stopping verification, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through comfortable acceleration transitions and automatic-operation service recovery. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究停準制動軌跡。原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。敏感度只改 v=20 至 22 m/s，輸出變為 335.5 m；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究舒適加速度過渡：原創假想教學輸入：起始加速度 a0=0 m/s2；終點加速度 a1=0.9 m/s2；過渡時間 dt=3 s。公式 y=(a1-a0)/dt，代入得 y=0.3 m/s3。邊界：僅計線性加速度斜坡的平均加加速度，不代表振動舒適度完整指標。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元比較相同站距下的早煞與晚煞軌跡，將停車位置誤差分成延遲與制動能力兩部分。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate stopping brake trajectory. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. For sensitivity, change only v=20 to 22 m/s; the output becomes 335.5 m. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate comfortable acceleration transitions: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial acceleration a0=0 m/s2; final acceleration a1=0.9 m/s2; transition time dt=3 s. Formula y=(a1-a0)/dt gives y=0.3 m/s3. Boundary: Average jerk of a linear acceleration ramp only; this is not a complete vibration-comfort metric. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Compare early and late braking over the same approach, separating stopping-position error caused by latency from error caused by available deceleration. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 停準制動軌跡~Stopping brake trajectory
units.title: 停準制動軌跡~Stopping brake trajectory
units.mechanism: 本單元比較相同站距下的早煞與晚煞軌跡，將停車位置誤差分成延遲與制動能力兩部分。停止距離由反應期間的等速前進與制動期間的動能消散相加。速度增加會同時增加兩項，而減速度只影響第二項；把控制命令發出時間當成制動力建立時間會漏掉一段距離。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。~Compare early and late braking over the same approach, separating stopping-position error caused by latency from error caused by available deceleration. Stopping distance combines constant-speed travel during response with kinetic-energy removal during braking. Speed changes both contributions, whereas deceleration changes only the second. A command timestamp is not the instant at which the full braking force becomes available. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.
units.verify: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。以「停準制動軌跡」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement. For stopping brake trajectory, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。回到「停準制動軌跡」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Weak deceleration and delayed response both cause an overrun, but the onset of the speed-curve change distinguishes these causes. Trace the input chain for stopping brake trajectory. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成~Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent.
units.practice: 只把初速 v 從 20 改成 22 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 280 變為 335.5 m。先說明「停準制動軌跡」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only initial speed v from 20 to 22 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 280 to 335.5 m. Explain the causal direction for stopping brake trajectory, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 舒適加速度過渡~Comfortable acceleration transitions
units.title: 舒適加速度過渡~Comfortable acceleration transitions
units.mechanism: 本單元把加速度命令的斜坡與站立乘客的短時擾動連結，明確區分平滑命令與平滑實際反應。加加速度描述加速度改變的快慢，與最高加速度是不同的舒適性指標。相同速度增量可由平滑過渡或突變控制產生，站立乘客受到的瞬態擾動卻不同；控制器飽和也會截斷原先規畫的平滑曲線。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：僅計線性加速度斜坡的平均加加速度，不代表振動舒適度完整指標。~Relate the acceleration-command ramp to short transient disturbance for standing passengers, distinguishing a smooth requested command from a smooth measured response. Jerk measures how rapidly acceleration changes and is distinct from peak acceleration. Smooth and abrupt commands can produce the same speed increment while imposing different transient disturbances on standing passengers. Actuator saturation can truncate an otherwise smooth planned transition. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Average jerk of a linear acceleration ramp only; this is not a complete vibration-comfort metric.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：起始加速度 a0=0 m/s2；終點加速度 a1=0.9 m/s2；過渡時間 dt=3 s。公式 y=(a1-a0)/dt，代入得 y=0.3 m/s3。邊界：僅計線性加速度斜坡的平均加加速度，不代表振動舒適度完整指標。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial acceleration a0=0 m/s2; final acceleration a1=0.9 m/s2; transition time dt=3 s. Formula y=(a1-a0)/dt gives y=0.3 m/s3. Boundary: Average jerk of a linear acceleration ramp only; this is not a complete vibration-comfort metric.
units.verify: 先去除速度微分造成的高頻雜訊，再比較加速度計與里程推估的斜坡時間。以「舒適加速度過渡」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Control differentiation noise before comparing ramp duration from an accelerometer with the duration inferred from odometry. For comfortable acceleration transitions, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 過度濾波可能讓顯示曲線看似平順，卻掩蓋真實衝擊；致動飽和則留下平頂加速度。回到「舒適加速度過渡」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Excessive filtering can hide a real shock behind a smooth display, whereas actuator saturation leaves a flat-topped acceleration trace. Trace the input chain for comfortable acceleration transitions. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 最高加速度相同就代表乘坐感受一定相同~Equal peak acceleration guarantees an identical ride sensation.
units.practice: 只把過渡時間 dt 從 3 改成 3.3 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.3 變為 0.272727 m/s3。先說明「舒適加速度過渡」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only transition time dt from 3 to 3.3 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.3 to 0.272727 m/s3. Explain the causal direction for comfortable acceleration transitions, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 牽引力功率限制~Traction force and power limits
units.title: 牽引力功率限制~Traction force and power limits
units.mechanism: 本單元比較定力區與功率受限區的加速需求，檢查速度規畫是否要求致動器無法提供的力。牽引力先克服阻力，剩餘部分才增加列車動量。輪周機械功率等於牽引力乘速度，因此低速大力不必然等於高功率；電源側功率另受效率、輔助負載及回生可受納性影響。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：集中質量與定阻力模型，未含輪軸轉動慣量、坡度或黏著上限。~Compare acceleration demand in force-limited and power-limited regions, checking whether a speed plan asks for more force than the actuator can deliver. Traction force first overcomes resistance; the remainder changes train momentum. Mechanical power at the wheel equals force times speed, so a large low-speed force need not imply high power. Electrical input also depends on efficiency, auxiliaries and regenerative receptivity. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Lumped mass and fixed resistance; rotating inertia, gradient and adhesion limits are omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：列車質量 m=180000 kg；加速度 a=0.6 m/s2；等效阻力 R=12000 N；速度 v=15 m/s。公式 y=(m*a+R)*v/1000，代入得 y=1800 kW。邊界：集中質量與定阻力模型，未含輪軸轉動慣量、坡度或黏著上限。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train mass m=180000 kg; acceleration a=0.6 m/s2; equivalent resistance R=12000 N; speed v=15 m/s. Formula y=(m*a+R)*v/1000 gives y=1800 kW. Boundary: Lumped mass and fixed resistance; rotating inertia, gradient and adhesion limits are omitted.
units.verify: 將速度與牽引力同步取樣，對照加速度反推的慣性力，並另列輔助設備耗電。以「牽引力功率限制」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Synchronize speed and traction-force samples, compare inertial force inferred from acceleration, and account separately for auxiliary consumption. For traction force and power limits, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把電網輸入功率直接當成輪周功率會高估加速能力，低速輪滑亦可使電流很高而車速不升。回到「牽引力功率限制」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Treating grid input as wheel power overstates acceleration capability; low-speed slip can produce high current without increasing train speed. Trace the input chain for traction force and power limits. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 牽引電流變大就能保證車速增加得更快~Higher traction current guarantees a greater train acceleration.
units.practice: 只把列車質量 m 從 180000 改成 198000 kg（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1800 變為 1962 kW。先說明「牽引力功率限制」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only train mass m from 180000 to 198000 kg (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1800 to 1962 kW. Explain the causal direction for traction force and power limits, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 節能滑行與回生~Coasting and regenerative energy
units.title: 節能滑行與回生~Coasting and regenerative energy
units.mechanism: 本單元以同一抵達時刻比較滑行與回生的能量帳，將準點需求和可受納回生能量分開記錄。回生能量的上限先受列車動能限制，再受轉換損失與受電端容量限制。速度平方決定動能量級，回生率不能單獨說明整趟能耗；若鄰車或儲能無法接收，原可回收的能量仍可能轉為電阻熱。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：忽略旋轉動能、坡度位能及輔機，效率固定且假設有足夠受納容量。~Compare coasting and regeneration for an identical arrival time, keeping punctuality requirements separate from the energy that the receiving supply can accept. Recoverable energy is bounded first by kinetic energy and then by conversion losses and receiver capacity. The square of speed sets the energy scale, while recovery efficiency alone cannot describe journey consumption. Energy may still become resistor heat when nearby trains or storage cannot accept it. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Rotating energy, elevation and auxiliaries are omitted; efficiency is constant and receiving capacity is assumed adequate.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：等效質量 m=180000 kg；速度 v=22 m/s；回收效率 eta=0.7 1。公式 y=0.5*m*v*v*eta/3.6e6，代入得 y=8.47 kWh。邊界：忽略旋轉動能、坡度位能及輔機，效率固定且假設有足夠受納容量。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: equivalent mass m=180000 kg; speed v=22 m/s; recovery efficiency eta=0.7 1. Formula y=0.5*m*v*v*eta/3.6e6 gives y=8.47 kWh. Boundary: Rotating energy, elevation and auxiliaries are omitted; efficiency is constant and receiving capacity is assumed adequate.
units.verify: 比較電機側與直流母線能量積分，分開記錄制動電阻消耗與儲能充電。以「節能滑行與回生」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Compare integrated machine-side and DC-bus energy, keeping braking-resistor dissipation distinct from energy stored. For coasting and regenerative energy, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 電壓過高限制回生時，制動力仍可能由混合制動維持，不能由低回收量直接判定制動失效。回到「節能滑行與回生」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~High bus voltage can restrict regeneration while blended braking preserves stopping effort; low recovered energy alone does not prove brake failure. Trace the input chain for coasting and regenerative energy. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 有回生制動的列車就不會產生任何制動熱~A train with regenerative braking produces no braking heat.
units.practice: 只把速度 v 從 22 改成 24.2 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 8.47 變為 10.2487 kWh。先說明「節能滑行與回生」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only speed v from 22 to 24.2 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 8.47 to 10.2487 kWh. Explain the causal direction for coasting and regenerative energy, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 地標資料年齡~Age of landmark observations
units.title: 地標資料年齡~Age of landmark observations
units.mechanism: 本單元追蹤地標通過到速度控制器採用資料的時間，避免把高定位精度誤認為低控制延遲。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。即使感測器本身準確，封包等待與處理延遲仍會擴大當前位置的不確定範圍；接收時間不能取代量測時間，否則不同子系統可能各自認為資料是新的。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。~Track time from landmark passage to use by the speed controller, avoiding confusion between precise positioning and low control-loop latency. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions. Even an accurate sensor can yield an uncertain current location after queuing and processing delays. Reception time cannot substitute for measurement time because subsystems could then each mistakenly regard stale information as new. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors.
units.verify: 保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。以「地標資料年齡」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position. For age of landmark observations, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 時鐘偏移會偽裝成網路延遲，重設時間戳又可能隱藏陳舊資料，需用獨立時間基準辨認。回到「地標資料年齡」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Clock offset can imitate network delay, while timestamp replacement can conceal stale data; an independent time reference distinguishes them. units.anchor: 關門發車介面~Door closure and departure interface
units.title: 關門發車介面~Door closure and departure interface
units.mechanism: 本單元分析旅客服務結束到發車條件成立的交接，車門狀態只是必要輸入而不是獨立發車授權。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。各門均分旅客時可用總服務率估算，但熱門樓梯旁的門通常更壅塞；瓶頸門完成時間控制發車，平均流率因此不能保證最忙車門也能按時結束。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。~Analyse the handoff from completed passenger service to departure readiness; door status is a necessary input rather than an independent departure authority. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences. Dividing by total service rate assumes an even passenger distribution, yet doors near popular stairs are often more crowded. The busiest door governs completion, so average flow cannot guarantee timely clearance at that door. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。公式 y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed，代入得 y=30.75 s。邊界：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Formula y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed gives y=30.75 s. Boundary: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.

For door closure and departure interface, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Trace the input chain for door closure and departure interface. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Recalculate 30.75 to 30.8542 s. Explain the causal direction for door closure and departure interface, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 速度閉迴路時序~Speed-loop timing budget
units.title: 速度閉迴路時序~Speed-loop timing budget
units.mechanism: 本單元把速度感測、通訊、控制計算與牽引建立串成同一事件鏈，尋找真正限制反應的階段。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Link speed sensing, communication, control computation and traction build-up into one event chain to identify the stage that actually limits response. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
units.verify: 沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。以「速度閉迴路時序」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load. For speed-loop timing budget, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「速度閉迴路時序」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Trace the input chain for speed-loop timing budget. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Recalculate 0.25 to 0.258 s. Explain the causal direction for speed-loop timing budget, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 駕駛模式交接驗證~Driving-mode handover verification
units.title: 駕駛模式交接驗證~Driving-mode handover verification
units.mechanism: 本單元建立自動與人工駕駛模式的需求案例矩陣，對不完整交接保留明確狀態而不猜測完成。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Build a requirement-case matrix for automatic and manual mode transitions, retaining an explicit incomplete state rather than inferring a successful handover. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.verify: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「駕駛模式交接驗證」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For driving-mode handover verification, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Trace the input chain for driving-mode handover verification. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. units.anchor: 自動駕駛服務恢復~Automatic-operation service recovery
units.title: 自動駕駛服務恢復~Automatic-operation service recovery
units.mechanism: 本單元比較短暫模式退出與長時間設備維修的服務影響，避免把可用度當作行車安全證明。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。~Compare service effects of brief mode withdrawals and lengthy equipment repairs, avoiding the use of availability as proof of operating safety. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
units.verify: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「自動駕駛服務恢復」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. For automatic-operation service recovery, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Trace the input chain for automatic-operation service recovery. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Recalculate 0.998004 to 0.997805 1. units.anchor: 停準重複試驗推論~Inference from repeated stopping tests
units.title: 停準重複試驗推論~Inference from repeated stopping tests
units.mechanism: 本單元把停準測試的零失敗紀錄轉成有限的統計證據，明列載重、黏著與車型抽樣範圍。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。~Turn a failure-free stopping-test record into bounded statistical evidence, explicitly defining the sampled loads, adhesion conditions and vehicle types. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
units.verify: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「停準重複試驗推論」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For inference from repeated stopping tests, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Trace the input chain for inference from repeated stopping tests. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for inference from repeated stopping tests, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
